outcome: identification of risk groups for cesarean delivery
cohort: All deliveries attended at Hospital de Manises from January 1, 2015 to December 31, 2016 (n=3171)
finding: The implementation of the Robson 10-Group Classification System allowed for the identification of risk groups for cesarean delivery, with the highest rate (97.6%) in nulliparous breech presentations (group 6).
